scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web,desktop -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.dev:desktop: wait-on http://localhost:5173 http://localhost:4000/api/employees && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 npm run dev -w desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run dist:mac -w desktop
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run dist:win -w desktop
